stocks.discussion_driver: Humana beat Q2 estimates on adjusted EPS ($7.61 vs. $7.22 expected) and revenue ($40.87B vs. $40.61B), but trimmed full-year GAAP EPS guidance, causing an initial 6%+ decline on July 29. The selloff triggered multiple bullish analyst upgrades on July 30 — Leerink to Outperform ($513 target) and Piper Sandler to Overweight ($463 target, up from $254) — as analysts see 2028 EPS of ~$31 as too attractive at current valuations.
bull_case: Multiple analyst upgrades on July 30 (Leerink $513, Piper Sandler $463, Wells Fargo $502) signal restored confidence after the Q2 adjusted EPS beat of 5.4%; Healthcare Plans revenue grew 23.5% YoY underlining the franchise's operational recovery

Medicare Advantage business stabilization and a 70% YTD stock run reflect that the worst of the MA medical cost ratio cycle may be behind Humana, positioning for meaningful margin recovery in 2027-2028
bear_case: GAAP EPS guidance was cut despite the adjusted beat, reflecting persistent medical cost ratio pressures; analyst consensus projects forward EPS to shrink ~30.7% over the next 12 months

Hold is still the dominant Street consensus and the stock remains ~12.8% below its 52-week high of $428.88, with many analysts waiting on Medicare Advantage enrollment data before committing to an upgrade

stocks.discussion_driver: Corcept surged ~17-22% after Q2 results dramatically beat expectations — revenue of $256.1M vs. $219M estimate (+16.8%), with Lifyorli generating $47.6M in its first full quarter (FDA-approved March 2026 for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer). Full-year 2026 guidance was raised to $1.1-1.2B. The stock hit a new 52-week high as the oncology drug emerged as a legitimate second growth engine alongside the core Korlym franchise, clocking its best single day in nearly 16 months.
bull_case: Lifyorli launch is tracking as one of the strongest in biotech — 1,300+ patients on therapy, 1,000+ unique prescribers, and $47.6M in its first full quarter; management projects U.S. annual revenue potential exceeding $1B in ovarian cancer alone

Q2 revenue rose 32% YoY with record new Korlym prescriptions alongside the Lifyorli ramp; guidance raise to $1.1-1.2B for FY 2026 and an FDA PDUFA date of Dec. 17 for relacorilant provide multiple near-term catalysts
bear_case: A February 2026 Federal Circuit ruling found Teva's generic mifepristone did not infringe key Korlym patents, intensifying generic competition risk on the core revenue driver that still accounts for the majority of sales

Adjusted operating margin fell 7.4 percentage points YoY to 16.1% as R&D and SG&A tied to oncology launches escalate; Wolfe Research issued an Underperform rating with a $50 price target citing shares pricing in aggressive growth assumptions

stocks.discussion_driver: Bloom Energy delivered a record-breaking Q2 with $1.065B revenue (+165.5% YoY) — its first-ever billion-dollar quarter — driven by hyperscaler and AI data center demand for solid oxide fuel cells. Management raised FY 2026 guidance to $3.9-4.2B (100% growth). Mizuho upgraded to Outperform ($242 target) on July 30, citing cheap valuation and improving power pricing, sending the stock up 28% for its best single-session gain of the year.
bull_case: Q2 product revenue jumped 215% to $935.4M as all major US hyperscalers plus over a dozen neoclouds and AI labs validated Bloom's behind-the-meter fuel cell power; FY guidance raised to $3.9-4.2B represents ~100% YoY growth and beat analyst consensus by 8.2%

Mizuho's Outperform upgrade ($242 target, +48% upside implied at time of upgrade) and Clear Street's Buy ($290 target) reflect growing Street conviction that Bloom has transitioned from speculative clean energy into a structural AI infrastructure supplier
bear_case: The stock fell 14.9% on July 24, continued sliding to $163.75 by July 29, then surged 28% on July 30 — extreme volatility reflects deep skepticism about revenue durability and customer concentration among a narrow hyperscaler base

Trailing P/E of 184.55x and revenue highly concentrated in AI/data center capex create significant valuation risk if hyperscaler buildout slows; Wells Fargo maintained Equal Weight with only a $176 target, well below today's close
